svg.text: Cross-PR noise comparison: improvements and remaining regressions
Error divided by same-seed FAST separate, 10,000 iterations. Below 1 is better; above 1 is worse.
Ten original raw-noise metrics (same order for every curve)
308 integration-error diagnostics, sorted from best to worst ratio
Zoom: #117 integration-error ratios, including extra-FAST controls
Sorted curves show each method's distribution, not matching diagnostics at matching ranks. No all-metrics winner.
#117 inputs: published seed-1 PNGs. Finite development tests; no unseen rendering or general state-of-the-art proof.
